description: National Physical Planning Department - Pilakatumulla Sri Pusparama Purana Viharaya Declared as an Urban Development Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically declaring an area of land (Pilakatumulla Sri Pushparama Purana Viharaya) as an urban development area under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. It includes detailed descriptions of land boundaries, lot numbers, hectares, and survey plans. While it mentions a minister's name (Prasanna Ranathunga), this is incidental to the main purpose of the document, which is land development and planning. The content does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette rather than a government-related type.
